import sys, importlib, base64
for _module_name in list(sys.modules):
    if _module_name == 'qresearch' or _module_name.startswith('qresearch.'):
        sys.modules.pop(_module_name, None)
importlib.invalidate_caches()
import qresearch.engineering_data as _engineering
_task = _engineering.load_task_input(_engineering.Path(_engineering.__file__).resolve().parents[1] / '_engineering_task_input.py')
_result = _engineering.run_research_task(_task)
print('AQRP_ENGINEERING_JSON ' + base64.b64encode(_engineering.canonical_json(_result)).decode('ascii'))
